issue_context.title: Issue with `Parenthesized Expression`
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

IdentifierReference is allowed in the Parenthesized Expression.
There are a lot of cases involving `Parenthesized Expression` that are incorrectly transformed.

### Input code

```typescript
import { foo } from "foo";

foo();                       // ⭕️
(foo)();                     // ❌

bar?.bar();                  // ⭕️
(bar as any)?.bar();         // ❌

bar.bar ||= 1;               // ⭕️
(bar.bar as number) ||= 1;   // ❌

class Bar {
  #bar = 1;

  bar() {
    this.#bar++;             // ⭕️
    (this.#bar)++;           // ❌
    this.#bar = 1;           // ⭕️
    (this.#bar) = 1;         // ❌
  }
}
```

### Config

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/swcrc",
  "jsc": {
    "parser": {
      "syntax": "typescript",
      "tsx": false
    },
    "target": "es2019"
  },
  "isModule": true,
  "module": {
    "type": "commonjs"
  }
}
```

### Playground link

[playground](https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.244&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA8vMLcgvKlGoVkjLz1eoVUgrys9VUAKylay5uICUhqa1Anagr6%2FwaO3U9zv6uTSA6jRxKQQpm9vDxZWUWGSvBySwqkMyC6hEIbFYITGvUhNDPZJZICmFmhpbBUN041DN0oOal1eam5RapInQAjMrOSexuFjBCaiqmktBQRmkHKSCC8gB2w4WVlAoycgs1gPJamtb47AOxNOAq9NEVQi1DsUoBTTX4zQKVSHcqFquWi4ADHWK1r8BAAA%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAAy2MSQ7CMBAE%2FzLiGCXADf%2BBR1hmsljxoumJIIr8d4bl1l2q7oNOCDMnT45m1Qo3DBEl9z8KLcJ9kWnAM0igjiICuYOqF7B8Evas%2FmVz3SsjyFLVNIWh0a%2FgZsXLxGoK43q%2B3MjQgnt5bCuTU9m4o%2FRvx%2FfG1FBSKjmCWnsD2rHcj6QAAAA%3D)

### Expected behavior

Parenthesized Expression should be transformed correctly.

### Actual behavior
